card.text: GJ 3929 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 3929 b"
sources.quote: GJ 3929 b is a confirmed exoplanet located 52 light-years away orbiting the red dwarf star GJ 3929.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 3929. Its orbit and size follow Beard et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 3929 b"
sources.quote: It is an Earth-sized planet, having a radius only 9% larger than that of Earth.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.

temperature.title: Bare rock from its eclipse depth
temperature.summary: A model, not a map: a bare rock as bright at 15 µm as the measured day side. About 870 K under the star, dark at night.
